whenToUse: Every action: save, create, submit, open a dialog.
One primary (accent) button per view for the main action; secondary/ghost for the rest.
Links that look like buttons via asChild.
avoidWhen: Navigating to another page in body text — use a link.
Several primary buttons in one view — demote all but one.
a11y: Icon-only buttons (IconButton) need aria-label plus a Tooltip.
The loading state keeps the label for screen readers and sets aria-busy; do not disable without explaining why.
